springBeans.checkProxyMethods.title: Warn when @Transactional, @Async, @Cacheable and similar annotations sit on private, final or static methods

springBeans.checkScheduled.title: Warn when a @Scheduled method declares parameters

springBeans.checkDuplicateNames.title: Warn when two beans of the project share a name (Check Spring Configuration only)

springBeans.checkConfiguration.title: Check @Configuration classes and @Bean methods
springBeans.checkConfiguration.description: Warn about private or final @Bean methods in proxied @Configuration classes, @Bean calls in proxyBeanMethods = false classes, and initMethod/destroyMethod names a project class lacks

springBeans.checkNaming.title: Hint when an explicit bean name starts with a capital letter

springBeans.checkSelfInvocation.title: Warn about calls to proxied methods in the same class
springBeans.checkSelfInvocation.description: Warn when a method calls a @Transactional, @Async or @Cacheable method of its own class (text-based, may miss or over-report)

springBeans.checkUnresolvedReferences.title: Warn about names and files no project source defines
springBeans.checkUnresolvedReferences.description: Warn about names and files no project source defines (@DependsOn, @Lookup, @Scheduled scheduler, @ComponentScan and @PropertySource paths, XML ref/depends-on/placeholders). Runs in Check Spring Configuration only; library beans are invisible, so it may over-report

springBeans.checkAop.title: Check AOP configuration
springBeans.checkAop.description: Report incomplete AOP configuration (aop:config, pointcuts, aspects, advisors, advice) in Spring XML files, and pointcut designators Spring AOP does not support in XML and Java @Aspect classes. Java classes are checked by Check Spring Configuration only

springBeans.checkInjectionAnnotations.title: Check injection annotations
springBeans.checkInjectionAnnotations.description: Report @Autowired, @Value, @Inject and @Resource on static members, conflicting @Autowired constructors, and @Required outside a setter

springBeans.checkAsync.title: Report @Async methods that return a value instead of void or a Future

springBeans.checkCache.title: Check cache annotations
springBeans.checkCache.description: Report cache annotations without a cache name, on interfaces, combined @Cacheable and @CachePut, unbalanced SpEL brackets, and key with keyGenerator (or cacheManager with cacheResolver)

springBeans.checkKotlinSpringPlugin.title: Check Kotlin Spring usage
springBeans.checkKotlinSpringPlugin.description: Kotlin: missing kotlin-spring plugin, redundant open modifiers when it is on, router pathVariable names no path declares, and ::class.java arguments that reified extensions replace

springBeans.checkXml.title: Check Spring XML
springBeans.checkXml.description: Check Spring XML: bean attributes, values, scopes, abstract references, style hints, component-scan filters, missing imports, and project bean classes (abstract, factory-method, constructor-arg, init/destroy, @Required)
